DRIVING INSTRUCTOR LESSON PRICING CALCULATOR · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

What does a driving lesson really earn after the car?

Fuel and wear for the miles you drive to collect pupils, a car whose fixed costs are paid whether the lesson happens or not, unpaid gaps between pupils and cancellations all come out of the fee. Enter your numbers to see profit per lesson, your break-even price, the price that reaches the profit you want, and what a block-booking discount does to the year.

Nothing is uploaded. Your numbers are read in this browser and never leave your device — see the privacy note in the footer.

Price your lessons

Enter a lesson price, slots per week, miles per lesson, mpg and fuel price, then click Calculate.

Result

MeasureValue

Copies the figures and the disclaimer as plain text.

What this does and doesn't do

This applies the numbers you enter to one working year. Profit is before income tax and self-employment tax. It does not know your pupils, your area's market rate or your local rules, and it does not tell you what to charge.

Common questions

What should a driving instructor charge per lesson?

It depends on your own costs, not on the next instructor's rate. Enter your fuel, miles per lesson, car costs and the pay you want, and the calculator shows the break-even price and the price that reaches your target with the bookings you actually get.

Why do cancellations matter so much?

Your car costs the same whether the lesson happens or not. Spread over only the lessons that are paid for, fixed costs per lesson rise with every unpaid cancellation, on top of the lost fee.

What counts as fixed costs?

Typically insurance, dual controls, licence and registration fees, depreciation and the yearly share of servicing you do regardless of mileage. Enter your own yearly total. Franchise or desk fees paid weekly have their own box.

Is a block discount worth it?

Enter a block size and price to see the discount, the profit on each discounted lesson and what the year looks like if every lesson sold at that rate. It reports arithmetic; you decide what keeps pupils booking.

Is this tax or business advice?

No. Profit shown is before income tax and self-employment tax, from the numbers you type. It is not tax, legal, or financial advice.

We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record — nothing you enter is saved anywhere by this tool.

Everything runs in your browser. Your numbers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (pricing_calculated, summary_copied, example_loaded) are counted only in local storage on your device. Copying the summary puts it on your clipboard and nowhere else. The counts can be deleted with the button below. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured.

Pricing music lessons instead of driving lessons? The music lesson break-even calculator finds the minimum per-lesson price that clears your target pay after cancellations, prep and travel.

Choosing between the standard mileage rate and actual car expenses for your tax return? The mileage deduction method calculator compares the two methods.
